name: xm64q4-hub-projects-setup
goal: Show a friendly setup state on Hub Projects when shared collaboration or GitHub are unavailable while preserving signed-in owner boundaries.

evidence: Live authenticated Hub reported BrowserApiRequestError on /projects with collaboration-disabled. Unavailable collaboration uses a friendly setup state. GitHub configuration shows a friendly fallback. Owner and non-owner authorization remain server-enforced.

The standardized account Projects tests mocked a configured GitHub and successful collaboration list even for signed-in non-owners. Strengthen those tests using the production 503 and an unconfigured GitHub status, retaining assertions for account-specific overview access.
